build_activation_from_enum: build a PyTorch activation module from an Activation enum value like ReLU or GeLU
create_linear_layer: create a linear layer with optional activation and dropout using get_linear
create_feedforward_network: create a feedforward network with configurable hidden dimension multiplier and activation
get_no_weight_decay_params: get the set of parameter names that should exclude weight decay for a model
get_normalization_layer: get a normalization layer class like LayerNorm or RMSNorm from a NormalizationType enum
